title: 明亮卡通
text: Art direction A 明亮卡通: punchy rich teal UI with deep midnight-ink outlines, warm golden rewards and golden-orange fire button, thick black rounded edges, glossy toy-like bevels, high saturation and cheerful premium cartoon finish echoing the chunky reference 2 buttons. Vivid stylized handpainted 2D graphics, expressive green zombies, clean flat-shaded gradients with small specular accents. Interface should feel sculpted and playful with strong silhouettes, not realistic or 3D.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: polished high-fidelity mobile game interface concept, ONE complete edge-to-edge portrait game screenshot, aspect ratio 9:19.5, target 1080x2340. No device frame, no desktop, no multiple screens, no explanatory labels outside UI.
Input image 1 is the current game and content/layout reference: preserve the colorful handpainted chibi 2D postapocalyptic zombie setting, varied zombies and chunky armored gun vehicle. Input image 2 is ONLY the button form, professional game UI finish and information density reference; do not reproduce fantasy pinball gameplay or monetization.
Required layout: a spacious gameplay arena covers at least 70% of the complete screen height. Cream cracked road clearing with sparse roadside shrubs and salvage. Chibi zombies mainly in upper half with large clear spaces, player armored olive gun vehicle in lower-middle, visible bright projectiles shooting upward and tiny impact sparks, no gore. Do not obscure arena with menus or a huge title. Compact top HUD occupying about7% screen: team level badge exact '7', XP gauge exact '640 / 1400', three currency icons with values '549', '31', '0'. Small orange hero reward badge at upper-right below top HUD with a stylized hero portrait and crown, compact. Tiny LANDSCAPE battle progress thumbnail at lower-left above controls, only about20% screen width and9% height, actual little gameplay scene, exact label '搜刮 5关'. Keep thumbnail unobtrusive.
Bottom action area about20% screen: very clear large premium chunky rounded fire control exact '开火', left ammunition inventory black-and-gold cartridge icon and exact '680'. Single compact row of four selectable multiplier buttons exact '×1' '×5' '×20' '×100', ×1 selected. Bottom row of FOUR generous chunky icon navigation buttons with exact Chinese labels '搜刮' '猎场' '英雄' '内城'; 猎场 selected. Strong icon craft, clear hierarchy, generous touch spacing, superb typography and small highlights; elements fit entirely inside one portrait screen. All text listed must be legible and exact; omit all other text except small valid game details when necessary.
Never add shop, payment, offer, first-purchase, ad, timer, social chat buttons, unrelated features, fantasy props, or large floating battle panels. No full-width desktop panels. Professional shipped mobile game screenshot, not a wireframe.

Vivid stylized handpainted 2D graphics, expressive green zombies, clean flat-shaded gradients with small specular accents. Interface should feel sculpted and playful with strong silhouettes, not realistic or 3D.

title: 军械装甲
text: Art direction B 军械装甲: bespoke military supply UI with desaturated petrol blue and slate metal armor plates, beveled clipped corners that still have friendly rounded radii, recessed dark gauges, restrained brushed painted steel, small visible bolts, hazard-yellow tabs and warm yellow-orange fire control, embossed tactical icons. Premium tactile military industrial UI alongside friendly colorful handpainted 2D chibi zombies and armored vehicle. Avoid gritty horror, photorealism, realistic 3D, futuristic sci-fi. Give the controls a distinctly armored construction, not merely a recolor of toy buttons.

title: 暖色营地
text: Art direction C 暖色营地: a warm premium survivor field journal interface, ivory paper labels, olive and burnt-orange colors, rounded warm wood/salvage frames, small stitched canvas details, illustration print charm, subtle paper grain, thick clean cocoa outlines and beautiful pictorial icons. Warm soft sunny handpainted 2D chibi apocalypse game art. Main fire button is tactile burnt-orange enamel within a rounded reclaimed-wood frame. Bottom navigation has chunky rounded illustrated wood-and-paper tabs, precise legible labels. Cozy but active combat, not horror, fantasy or 3D. Construction and typography should be distinctly field journal / survivor camp, not a recolor of metal or plastic.
